description: Wallets whose large orders (at least $10k) on one Hyperliquid market tended to come before price moved their way within 30 minutes, over the last 7 or 30 days. Per wallet: the number of scored orders, their total notional, a lead score (notional-weighted average 30-minute move in the order's direction, in basis points), a hit rate (share of orders followed by a move their way), the last order time and the share of its large orders cancelled without a fill. Needs at least 5 scored orders per wallet; the response states the formulas. Use it to find wallets worth watching on one market, then check them with get_trader_profile or get_user_state. Past activity does not predict future results.

market.description: Market: BTC-PERP, xyz:NVDA-PERP, HYPE/USDC, or a Hyperliquid name (BTC, @107, xyz:NVDA)

name: get_early_movers

formula.description: How the lead score is computed

cancel_ratio_30d.description: Share of large orders cancelled without a fill

hit_rate.description: Share of orders followed by a move in their direction

notional_usd.description: Notional of scored orders in USD
